raw_segments.text: Presently the chambers gave up their fair tenants one after another.
Each came out gaily and airily, with dress that gleamed lustrous through the dusk.
For a moment they stood grouped together at the other extremity of the gallery, conversing
in a key of sweet subdued vivacity.
